correction_note: the process was launched before the leakage control was fixed, so it ran the F1-at-0.5 version, scored 0.0000, concluded 'usable' and emitted NO_DETECTABLE_EFFECT_ON_AGRICULTURE. That verdict is withdrawn. The measured outcome -- VEG_AGRI recall -0.199 with precision +0.169 (CI excludes zero) -- is the predicted signature of the network learning the label's construction rule (VEG_AGRI positive rate 0.0081), not evidence about whether pre-event context helps. The hypothesis remains untested.
superseded_reason: p71 computed change features by subtracting linear gamma0 values although the feature contract specified dB-domain changes. The mathematical definition of the input features changed, not a model hyperparameter, so this model is superseded rather than re-run. Nothing is deleted: weights, config, split manifest, normalisation, threshold, test metrics, bootstrap and leakage analysis are retained as a forensic trail. Its test F1 must NOT be presented as a primary scientific result, and must not appear in the same table as corrected models as though it were a peer ablation. Additionally, BASE_CLASS is an ingredient of the weak label (p69b builds the semantic state as BASE_CLASS x M2) and ranks it alone at AUC 0.955 / AP 0.740 against a prevalence of 0.164, so this run describes label structure and does not test whether pre-event context helps. That finding is domain-independent and survives the rebuild.
